facts: Parties: Delamere Energy plc (Buyer), Orwell Energy plc (Seller); the Company is Brightwater Bioscience plc.
This Agreement is dated 27 November 2026; Closing is scheduled for 15 March 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $325,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 72 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 60 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
